gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Wide-mouthed and loud, Cherry Swash opens its c like a horseshoe and makes diagonals as heavy as its verticals. And Chiron Hei HK takes over below with a bracelet-like c, modern and sensible enough to carry a long page.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-commissioner: Commissioner reads smoothly, with no clogged curves and every stroke held to one thickness. But Cherry Swash is the one that grabs attention, its horseshoe c and heavy diagonals doing the showing off that the body deliberately skips.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-dotgothic16: That horseshoe-shaped c and the diagonals as heavy as the verticals make Cherry Swash instantly recognizable up top. DotGothic16 follows in tube-like strokes.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-el-messiri: El Messiri reads cleanly, with a moderate thick-thin ratio and a wide slot between the c's two ends. And since Cherry Swash handles the attention, this body can go a touch larger without losing its modern feel.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-electrolize: Cherry Swash opens its c wide like a horseshoe and draws every diagonal as heavy as a vertical. And Electrolize, with an open-jawed c like pliers, can sit a size or two smaller below it.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-elms-sans: Elms Sans draws a ballpoint-plain line with a see-through gap in each s, which leaves the page uncluttered. Its best quality is how quietly it lets Cherry Swash be loud.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-finlandica: Finlandica gives its e crossbars open mouths and a constant-width outline you could trace with a finger, which keeps things clean. Over a long page Finlandica stays tidy and easy going, while Cherry Swash waits above with its horseshoe c.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-google-sans: Loud on top, mellow below. Cherry Swash brings horseshoe c shapes and heavy diagonals, while Google Sans pulls its terminals well back and keeps downstrokes and curves uniform, so the two never fight for attention.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-google-sans-flex: Cherry Swash flings its c open like a horseshoe and makes diagonals as heavy as the verticals. Google Sans Flex steps in beneath with stroke ends cut like one ribbon, so the heading gets the swagger and the text stays composed.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-gothic-a1: Stencil-cut and bold, Cherry Swash opens its c like a horseshoe while Gothic A1 keeps a splayed c terminal below. The strongest quality is how approachable the body feels beside it.
